name: jui-chart-vue
description: A Vue 3 chart library: line, area, bar/column, pie, donut. A from-scratch Vue port of jui-chart's (juijs-graph) core rendering engine.
author: search5

_dependencyNotes.juijs-graph: Deliberate, PERMANENT exception to this project's otherwise strict zero-runtime-dependency-on-jui-chart/juijs-graph rule (Phases A-D reimplemented every SVG-engine file from scratch instead) - see PORT_STATUS.md's Phase E policy note. Applies ONLY to files that are generic, non-chart-domain utility code (e.g. kinetic.js's standalone physics object, imported as-is + typed via src/vendor/kinetic.d.ts rather than hand-ported) - real chart/axis/rendering-engine logic is still planned for an eventual genuine Vue/TS port and never gets this treatment. Pinned to the exact version jui-chart/package.json itself uses as its own juijs-graph devDependency.
_dependencyNotes.jui-graph-ts: Sibling project at /home/search5/cl/jui-graph-ts - a complete, from-scratch TypeScript (real ES classes, no runtime registry) port of juijs-graph, published separately to npm. Linked via `file:` since it isn't on the npm registry yet. See PORT_STATUS.md's Phase G section for the composable-by-composable migration mapping and rationale - most of jui-chart-vue's composables stay hand-ported (either jui-chart's own leaf logic, out of jui-graph-ts's engine-only scope, or deliberately-independent implementations); only mathUtil.ts, useScale.ts's linear/ordinal scales, and usePolygon3d.ts's rotate/cube math migrate to real dependencies on this package.
_dependencyNotes.treemap-squared (imranghory/treemap-squa: NOT listed under "dependencies" below because it was never published to npm (confirmed via `npm view treemap-squared` -> 404, GitHub-only) - there is no installable package to reference, so it is vendored as a raw file instead, same as src/vendor/kinetic.js (which similarly has no matching npm dependency entry since it lives in jui-chart's own source tree, not the installable juijs-graph package). PORT_STATUS.md's Phase F audit traced useTreemap.ts's squarify core (Container/normalize/squarify/improvesRatio/calculateRatio/flattenTreemap/sumMultidimensionalArray, plus the exact "the pseudocode in the Bruls paper has the direction of the comparison wrong" bugfix comment) to this specific library - jui-chart's own treemap.js is itself a restructured adaptation of it, not original code. The real upstream source is vendored near-unmodified at src/vendor/treemap-squared.js (see that file's own header comment for the full provenance/license text and the one line added for ES-module compatibility) and typed via src/vendor/treemap-squared.d.ts; src/composables/useTreemap.ts's squarifyRects() is a thin shim delegating to it, verified byte-identical (exact spec fixtures) / sub-1e-9-relative-error (random fuzz + non-integer inputs) against the prior hand-port before the swap - see src/vendor/treemap-squared.spec.ts and useTreemap.ts's squarifyRects() doc comment.
